Hi Alicia 

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps to get the POC kicked off: 

- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for FinPay's document-processing pipeline (latency < 250ms p50, cost objective target).
- Scope: 2-week POC, 3 core flows (invoice parsing, fraud flagging, customer support routing).
- Success metrics: throughput of 50 reqs/sec, end-to-end accuracy targets per flow (we can capture these in the kickoff).

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm kickoff attendees and environments (who will own API keys/infra on your side).
2) Redwood will share a POC playbook + short checklist (attached: POC-plan-finpay-v1.pdf).
3) Schedule a 1-hr technical kickoff in the week of Oct 26 - Rafael will lead the technical setup.

If that works, can you confirm participants and whether Oct 27 or Oct 28 in the morning PT works for your team?

I'll loop in Rafael for the tech details. Looking forward - we want to make the first setup as frictionless as possible.

Best,
